coding.rationale: Evidence describes medication reminders for the resident; failure to act means a missed dose, i.e. a care lapse triggered on a schedule.
Evidence cites periodic cognitive-training reminders the resident found helpful for training; missing sessions is a care lapse on a recurring schedule.
Resident used lighting when sad and found it relaxing; the outcome is alleviating negative emotional state, i.e. avoiding discomfort, applicable whenever sadness arises.
Evidence cites periodic reminders for eye drops; missed application is a care lapse bound to the reminder schedule.
Evidence cites periodic reminders to drink water; inadequate hydration reflects a care lapse cued on a periodic schedule.
Rules turn on lights after morning inactivity and under low light; insufficient lighting risks falls/harm and is triggered by threshold events (inactivity, low light).
Reminder to take medicine within a fixed evening window aims at timely intake; failure is a missed-dose care lapse in a scheduled context.
User is notified when the washing machine finishes; being unaware causes inconvenience and is triggered by the wash-cycle completion event.
Cleaning robot is activated when nobody is home; failure leaves cleaning undone and the rule applies only in the unoccupied context.
Turning off lights when nobody is home prevents wasted electricity; the responsibility optimizes resource use under the unoccupied condition.
Full-bin detection triggers urgent garbage notification; failure leaves waste accumulating, driven by the bin-full threshold event.
An acoustic warning fires when the paper is finished; the guarded outcome is avoiding a supply shortage detected at the empty event.
If the robot has not run by Sunday it is activated; the outcome is completing the weekly cleaning within a scheduled window, failure is the task left undone.
Floor cleaning is triggered when the house is empty or when people leave a room; failure leaves floors uncleaned, dominantly applied when areas are unoccupied.
When no bag is detected, sanitizing and bag replacement are triggered; failure means the bin lacks a bag (shortage) and hygiene, triggered by the missing-bag event.
